book_details.title: Precision Flow Control & Greenhouse Automation: Practical Manual for Smart Farm Maintenance and Operations
book_details.author: Inwoo Hwang
book_details.description: Precision Flow Control & Greenhouse Automation is a practical manual designed for smart farm operators, greenhouse technicians, and vocational students (such as those entering the German Gärtner Ausbildung). This book details the technical engineering principles of modern Venlo-style greenhouses, automated microclimate zoning, high-temperature fluid controls, proportional mixing valves, EC/pH calibration, and biological pest control systems.
